title: Red Light Cafe
venue_description:
Atlanta's Premier Listening Room

Red Light Cafe has established itself as Atlanta's go-to intimate listening room since opening in the Virginia Highland neighborhood. Located on Amsterdam Walk near Piedmont Park this cozy venue seats over 100 and maintains a bohemian living room atmosphere that serves as the city's center for bluegrass Americana folk blues and jazz.

Music Programming

The venue's commitment to live music runs deep with programming seven nights a week. The flagship Wednesday Jazz Jam with the Gordon Vernick Quartet has become one of Atlanta's longest-running jazz sessions drawing both professional and amateur musicians. Gordon Vernick professor of music at Georgia State University and coordinator of the Rialto Youth Jazz Orchestra uses these sessions to mentor young players while maintaining the highest musical standards.

First Tuesday features comedy open mic hosted by Gwen Evans. The third Tuesday offers storytelling open mic for narrative performers. Various touring acts perform throughout the week across genres from alt-country to experimental jazz. The venue has also become known for hosting unique burlesque shows including Tease Tuesday Burlesque on the second Tuesday featuring ten acts of burlesque poetry aerial acrobatics and more.

Venue Atmosphere

The space emphasizes listening - when music plays audiences give it focused attention rather than treating it as background. Full bar and kitchen operate with quality food and drinks served throughout performances. The intimate layout ensures no bad sightlines and creates connection between performers and audience.

Practical Information

Most shows have advance tickets available online with sales ending one hour before door time. Jazz jam admission is $10 at door ($5 for performers/students with ID). The venue livestreams Wednesday jazz jams on YouTube. Hours: 7 PM - 12 AM Monday through Sunday. Kitchen open until 10 PM.

title: Napoleon's
venue_description:
Decatur's Music & Dining Destination

Napoleon's Grill has been a Decatur institution for decades combining Mediterranean-inspired American cuisine with a robust live music calendar. The restaurant and bar in the Oak Grove community has become particularly renowned for hosting some of Atlanta's most respected jam sessions.

Music Programming

Napoleon's features three distinct regular jam sessions each appealing to different musical communities. Monday nights belong to Joe Gransden's Jazz Jam (7:30-10:00 PM) which has been running for years and attracts musicians from ages 10 to 90. Gransden a veteran trumpeter and big band leader creates a relaxed no-pressure atmosphere where musicians of all levels can network and grow. His house band includes Tyrone Jackson (keyboards) Joel Powell (bass) and Chris Burroughs (drums).

The 2nd and 4th Thursday Blues Jam (7:30-10:00 PM) features Sandra Senn and the ladies of Blue Velvet Atlanta. These sessions invite musicians to bring instruments and showcase talent with dancing and jamming throughout the evening.

The 2nd and 4th Tuesday Acoustic Open Mic (7:30-10:00 PM) with Bill Sheffield and Spencer L. Kirkpatrick focuses on acoustic performances. Each artist performs two songs (10 minutes total). No amplifiers laptops or loopers allowed - pure acoustic performances only. Musicians must bring own instruments.

Dining

Full restaurant service with Mediterranean-American menu. The venue has become popular enough that Monday night jam sessions regularly pack the space from tables to bar area creating an enthusiastic supportive atmosphere for performers.

History

Gransden's jam session previously operated at Twain's Brewpub and Billiards in downtown Decatur before relocating to Napoleon's where it has thrived for the past several years.

title: Eddie's Attic
venue_description:
The Legendary Songwriters' Showcase

Eddie's Attic stands as one of America's most important songwriter development venues. Founded in 1991 by Eddie Owen this Decatur listening room has launched careers that shaped contemporary music. John Mayer Shawn Mullins Jennifer Nettles of Sugarland Clay Cook The Civil Wars Luke Combs Tyler Childers and countless others developed their artistry on this stage.

The Open Mic Tradition

For over 20 years Eddie's has hosted a weekly Monday night Songwriters Open Mic (starting at 7:30 PM) that draws both local and national acts. Hosted by Matt Arnett since 2012 the format gives each performer two songs with three finalists returning for a third song at evening's end competing for a cash prize and spot in the bi-annual Open Mic Shootout.

The Open Mic Shootout held twice yearly for 27 years has become legendary in songwriter circles. This competition provides rare exposure to music industry professionals and devoted fans. Past winners represent a who's who of contemporary music demonstrating the event's track record for identifying major talent.

Full Music Calendar

Beyond the open mic Eddie's presents touring acts nightly across genres from Americana to rock. Recent artists include rising stars and established Grammy winners. The venue's reputation ensures that playing Eddie's Attic carries significant weight in music industry circles.

Venue Details

Intimate listening room seating approximately 200. Full bar open until 11 PM or later. Kitchen serves until 10 PM with a menu featuring elevated pub fare. Last artist typically goes on stage around 10:30 PM. Sign-ups for open mic available online at eddiesattic.com/sign-up. Thursday evening also features patio comedy open mic hosted by Matt Talley with free entry.

Hours: 5 PM - 12 AM Monday through Sunday. The venue operates as both restaurant/bar and performance space with professional sound and lighting that rival larger venues.

title: The Waiting Room
venue_description:
Midtown's Secret Jazz Speakeasy

The Waiting Room occupies the upstairs space above Bon Ton Vietnamese/Cajun fusion restaurant creating one of Atlanta's most distinctive music venues. The 70s-themed cocktail bar features shag carpeting mirrors a glittering disco ball and decor that evokes the Korova Milk Bar from A Clockwork Orange mixed with Austin Powers aesthetics.

Tuesday Night Jazz

Every Tuesday evening from 8:30 PM to around midnight The Waiting Room hosts live jazz featuring Dallas Dawson's trio plus guests. The intimate space with curved booths covered in shaggy orange fur and dramatic red lighting creates perfect atmosphere for jazz listening. A $7 entertainment fee applies on jazz nights.

Cocktails & Atmosphere

The bar specializes in strong specialty cocktails including an absinthe Hurricane and other drinks inspired by Bourbon Street. While you can order from Bon Ton's full Cajun-Vietnamese menu downstairs the tight upstairs space means most patrons stick with drinks. No food service upstairs after 9:30 PM.

Access

Enter through Bon Ton's front entrance at 674 Myrtle Street NE ignore the hostess stand and head up the dark staircase immediately in front of you. Small parking lot available. The space books private events and hosts special themed nights including Pride celebrations and holiday parties.

Vibe

The venue attracts a diverse crowd from jazz enthusiasts to cocktail aficionados to those seeking Atlanta's most unique nightlife spaces. The eclectic interior design and quality live music make Tuesday nights particularly popular. The small intimate setting means shows can sell out so arriving earlier in the evening recommended.

title: TEN ATL
venue_description:
Keeping the Churchill Grounds Legacy Alive

TEN ATL in East Atlanta Village represents the continuation of Atlanta's most storied jazz tradition. When Churchill Grounds - the legendary jazz bar next to the Fox Theatre that operated for nearly two decades - closed following owner Sam Yi's passing in February 2025 the Monday Night Jazz Jam found new home at TEN ATL.

Monday Night Jazz Jam

Every Monday at 10 PM the Churchill Grounds Trio takes the stage: Larry Willson on drums (also serving as host) Kenny Banks Jr. on piano and Joel Powell on bass. These are the musicians who anchored Churchill Grounds' house band and they've brought the same vibe and commitment to TEN ATL. Musicians and jazz vocalists welcome to join - sign in with host upon arrival.

Churchill Grounds occasionally hosted drop-ins from touring musicians like Wynton Marsalis and Lady Gaga who stopped by after concerts in the city. That tradition of welcome continues at TEN ATL where the goal is keeping jazz alive one Monday night at a time.

Additional Programming

TEN ATL opens at 8 PM Mondays with the jazz jam starting at 10 PM. Other nights feature diverse entertainment including blues performances funk and soul dance parties with DJ sets and cigar lounge atmosphere. Friday nights feature DJ MAJESTIK while Saturday nights bring dressed-up dance parties.

Venue Details

Located in East Atlanta Village at 495 Flat Shoals Avenue SE. Musicians and vocalists pay $5 at door with no guaranteed seating (standing room). All reserved seating starts at $35. Food available from local restaurants in the area. Follow @TENATL on Instagram for nightly event updates. Monday Night Jazz is livestreamed - links available at Linktr.ee/TENATL.

title: Fat Matt's Rib Shack
venue_description:
Where Barbecue Meets the Blues

Fat Matt's Rib Shack has been an Atlanta institution since 1990 combining two great Southern traditions: barbecue and blues music. Located on Piedmont Avenue this legendary establishment serves mouth-watering pork ribs BBQ chicken and chopped pork while hosting live blues music.

Music Programming

Fat Matt's features regular live blues performances throughout the week including Fran's Jam on Tuesday evenings. The venue's commitment to the blues has made it a cornerstone of Atlanta's blues scene for over three decades. The intimate setting means performers and audience share close connection with no separation between stage and dining area.

Dining Experience

The menu is focused and excellent: pulled pork ribs chicken and classic sides like Brunswick stew. Expect lines out the door especially during peak times but the wait is worth it. The space is small and always packed creating lively energetic atmosphere. Counter service means knowing your order before reaching the front of line.

Vibe

Authentic dive atmosphere that embraces its character rather than trying to be upscale. This is real Atlanta - a place locals have been coming to for decades. The combination of exceptional barbecue and live blues in an intimate setting makes Fat Matt's unlike anywhere else in the city.

Hours

Monday: 12 PM - 7 PM. Tuesday-Thursday & Sunday: 11 AM - 9 PM. Friday-Saturday: 11 AM - 10 PM or 11 PM. Music schedule varies - check their website or social media for specific performance times.
